title: b7z9.5.1: TX seam — distinct TxError variant for oversized encapsulated datagrams
description: Smallest slice of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.5 (R-05-065 fragmentation wiring). stack.rs send_l2_payload_to returns ambiguous TxError::FrameEncode for payloads exceeding frame capacity (stack.rs:492-494). Add a dedicated TxError variant (NeedsFragmentation, doc: compressed SCHC payload exceeds one frame per spec/05-routing.md section 8.9 R-05-065; fragmentation engine wiring follows in sibling beads) and return it there. Add tokio tests: oversized payload -> NeedsFragmentation WITHOUT consuming a link tuple (check precedes try_next_link_tuple), normal payload still sends via LoopbackRadio. No protocol change; seam for b7z9.5.3.
